thread:
Sam Park: Heads up — Cobalt Partners renewal is ready to sign but procurement says the PO is delayed and signatures are queued in DocuSign. They need wire instructions by EOD Wed.
Priya Nair: Thanks. Do we have the finalized SOW/contract attached? I can push DocuSign reminder.
Sam Park: Yes, attached in the ticket. I've uploaded the signed SOW draft to Dropbox. PO is pending AP approval; they said 48 hrs.
Diego Ramos: @Sam can you confirm billing entity (US vs EU)? That often delays PO creation.
Sam Park: It's the US entity (Cobalt US Inc). I pinged procurement to confirm vendor code yesterday.
Linda Zhao: From onboarding side, customer wants an enablement session before go-live, but won't schedule until payment path is confirmed. Risk: potential start delay = 2 weeks.
Priya Nair: I'll set a DocuSign reminder and include wire instructions. Can someone paste the wiring details? @Diego?
Diego Ramos: Wire instructions: Bank: First Harbor, Routing: 021000021, Account: 123456789 (include invoicing ref: Cobalt-Redwood-2026). Confirm with Finance before sharing.
Sam Park: Finance confirmed. I'll add to the DocuSign instructions and send reminder.
DocuSign Bot: Reminder sent to signer: cjohnson@cobalt.com. DocuSign envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d. Status: waiting_signature.
Priya Nair: cjohnson is on vacation until Fri — can we re-route to alternate approver? They mentioned backup approver: c.tanaka@cobalt.com
Sam Park: Good catch. I just updated envelope routing to include c.tanaka as alternate.
Linda Zhao: For enablement, proposed slots next Tue/Thu 10am PT. Do we have content owners available? @Diego @Priya
Diego Ramos: I can cover model overview + security section on Tue 10am PT.
Priya Nair: I'll handle billing and rollout plan on Thu 10am PT. Pinged CS Playbooks to attach session deck.
Sam Park: Action items: (1) Priya send DocuSign reminder + wire instructions (2) Diego confirm billing entity in envelope copy (3) Linda schedule enablement tentative Tue/Thu 10am PT (4) I'll follow up with procurement daily.
Priya Nair: On it. Will update thread after send. :thumbsup:
Sam Park: Thanks team — flag if envelope not signed by Fri, we escalate to AE for exec-level push.
Priya Nair: Noted. I'll loop Jon from Sales if we hit Fri no-sign.
Diego Ramos: Will also add a short eval to make sure the quantization profile is ready for their expected latency. Not blocking signing but good to prep.
Sam Park: Great. Closing the loop here — will post updates.
